query_evidence.query: how long does a technical SEO audit take
observed_in: Current technical SEO provider FAQ headings
Current search-result titles and answer excerpts
query_evidence.interpretation: Evidence that buyers ask about audit timing; it does not establish search demand, volume, difficulty or the accuracy of provider timelines.

editorial_decision.buyer_question: How long does a technical SEO audit take?
editorial_decision.distinct_task: Separate diagnosis, implementation and verification milestones so a buyer can compare schedules with different scope and dependencies.

overlap_review: The audit-deliverables article defines what a useful report contains; this article defines milestone boundaries and schedule dependencies.
The audit-or-consultancy article chooses the engagement type; this article compares timing only after the engagement and ownership boundaries are defined.
The first-28-days Search Console article covers post-launch observation; this article separates that observation from audit delivery and implementation.
limitations: No universal audit duration, price, ranking result or demand estimate is claimed.
Third-party answer excerpts were used only as evidence that the wording exists; technical claims link to primary Google documentation.
Search visibility, external citations and qualified enquiries remain separate measures.
